items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: One belonged to Buck, uh, another bus driver, what we had, got with us.

ctx.x: He knew, he knew how to, he could, he could, he could twist it around his little finger in a minute, you know. And, uh, he kept folks laughing all the time. And, uh, we went down, took that car and two other cars. One belonged to Buck, uh, another bus driver, what we had, got with us. So he had, uh, a Ford automobile, two seats. And Mrs. Wisnet drove her car and we had another car, I think we read it. And, uh, that was almost getting to the winding up of King Oliver before Paul left. Mm-hmm. And, uh, he never did…
I, I was wondering, did y'all wear uniforms when you were with Oliver in the early days?
